commitResults.messageTitle: Update the initial code to simply greet the user and exit
Add command echoing and exit on 'bye'
Add tracking for 3 types of tasks: ToDos, Events, Deadlines
Add test-ui skill and some test cases
Handle errors by printing corresponding error messages
Use ArrayList instead of default array
Handle input handling and task persistence
commitResults.messageBody:
- Handle trimmed input and end-of-file cleanly
- Validate command arguments and task numbers
- Roll back in-memory changes when saving fails
- Escape special characters in task descriptions
- Parse escaped storage fields when loading tasks
- Write through a temporary file before replacing saved data
- Report malformed task data without crashing
- Add UI tests for persistence and input edge cases

commitResults.messageTitle: Add strict dd MM uuuu HH:mm DateTimeParser utility
Change Deadline and Event to store LocalDateTime
Improve clarity of date error by stating cause
Edit README.md to reflect commands and time formats
Refactor: Extract console interaction into Ui
commitResults.messageBody:
Move input handling and console output from Kaykay into a dedicated Ui
class, keeping chatbot behavior unchanged and improving separation of
responsibilities.

commitResults.messageTitle: Refactor: Extract task collection into TaskList
commitResults.messageBody:
Move task storage, lookup, mutation, and task-number validation into a
dedicated TaskList class, reducing Kaykay's dependency on ArrayList while
preserving existing behavior.

Inject the task data-file path through Storage's constructor and update
Kaykay to use an instance for loading and saving, improving configurability
while preserving existing persistence behavior.

commitResults.messageTitle: Refactor: Extract command parsing into Parser
commitResults.messageBody:
Move command recognition, argument validation, and date-time parsing from
Kaykay into Parser, returning immutable parsed commands while preserving
existing console behavior and error messages.

Move chatbot dependencies into Kaykay instance fields, initialize them
through a file-path constructor, and separate execution into run(), leaving
main() as a minimal entry point while preserving behavior.

Introduce an abstract Command execution model and concrete commands for
all supported chatbot actions. Move command behavior out of Kaykay while
preserving existing parsing, persistence, error handling, and console output.

Remove atomic-move fallback and retry logic from Storage while
preserving existing task persistence behavior after encountering
regression.

commitResults.messageTitle: Refactor: Organise classes into Java packages
commitResults.messageBody:
Group commands, models, parsing, storage, UI, and exceptions into
separate packages. Update imports, tests, and the UI test runner for
the packaged application entry point.

commitResults.messageTitle: Fix Gradle configuration for Kaykay application
Test: Add high-value JUnit coverage for core logic
commitResults.messageBody:
Cover parser validation, task models, task-list operations, storage
round-tripping, and task-mutating commands. Document the target of
testing approximately the top 50% of test-worthy methods.

commitResults.messageTitle: Docs: Add Javadoc for public APIs
commitResults.messageBody:
Document task models, command implementations, UI methods, constructors,
and test UI overrides, including relevant @param, @return, and @throws tags.
No application behavior was changed.

The Java sources have inconsistent Javadocs, names, and layout, making
the codebase harder to review against the project's standard.

Align documentation, naming, and layout across the Java sources while
preserving chatbot behavior. Keep the changes style-only so existing
console and persistence behavior remains unchanged.

The project lacks a shared reference for the SE-EDU Java coding
conventions, which makes style guidance harder to apply consistently.

Add a project skill and link it from the agent instructions. Keep the
skill in the repository so future Java changes follow the same naming,
layout, and documentation rules.

The project lacks a shared standard for commit messages and branch names.
This makes Git history and collaboration harder to keep consistent.

Add the Git standard skill and link it from the agent instructions. Track
project skills in .codex while continuing to ignore other local Codex state.

commitResults.messageTitle: Add find command for task descriptions
commitResults.messageBody:
Users need a way to locate tasks without scanning the full list.
Support case-insensitive keyword matching and preserve task order.
Add parser, command, model, UI, tests, documentation, and UI coverage.

The project has no automated enforcement for the required Java
coding standard.

Add the SE-EDU Checkstyle rules and Gradle integration so style
violations are detected for production and test sources.

Align two existing test assertions with the configured separator rule.
Checkstyle, JUnit, and UI tests pass.

commitResults.messageTitle: UI: Set up JavaFX application launcher
commitResults.messageBody:
Prepare Kaykay for the JavaFX GUI by adding cross-platform JavaFX
dependencies and a minimal JavaFX application scaffold.

Keep the console entry point available while Gradle launches the
JavaFX application by default.

Replace the placeholder greeting with a scrollable conversation area,
command input field, and Send button.

Add a reusable DialogBox control while keeping input handling for the
next increment.

commitResults.messageTitle: UI: Connect JavaFX interface to Kaykay
commitResults.messageBody:
Add command processing, response dialogs, Enter and Send interactions,
automatic scrolling, and farewell handling.

Align avatars with the conversation edges and test the new command
processing flow.

commitResults.messageTitle: UI: Move JavaFX views into FXML
commitResults.messageBody:
Separate the main window and dialog layouts from their Java controllers
using FXML.

Preserve command handling, auto-scrolling, and avatar orientation while
simplifying the JavaFX entry point.

commitResults.messageTitle: UI: Polish JavaFX layout and styling
commitResults.messageBody:
Improve the JavaFX interface with responsive anchors, minimum window
dimensions, styled controls, message bubbles, avatars, and scroll bars.

Remove console separators from GUI responses while preserving console
output behavior.

Allow tests to create task lists from individual tasks without
constructing an intermediate list. Retain the List<Task> constructor
for tasks loaded from storage.
